answer: Bond curve per operator: every new agent posts a refundable POA bond, and the required bond doubles for each extra agent whose funds thread back to the same funding wallet, so the operator pays 1, 2, 4, 8... and the tenth fake costs 512x the first. Bonds unlock only after 20 epochs with no slashing. If a sybil ring launders funds through fresh wallets to dodge the curve, its attestations still echo each other and the bonds sit on a ridge of shared risk: one fraud ruling slashes all linked bonds.
